description: Hey, I’m Dhyanesh, Grade 11 IB student in Toronto. I’ve coded in Python and Java since Grade 5 and like building things that react in real life. My last hackathon team won Best Use of Open Source AI with CaptainGemma. Now we’re building a spacecraft orbit sim that avoids debris and asteroids, plus a controller and a small sensor robot. Looking for: electronics, CAD/3D printing, UI design, presenting, physics/math. Portfolio: https://dhyaneshdev.vercel.app/
